Rita (CS): Pinging team 14C4 Drafting a short customer-facing ops playbook for onboarding + renewal-risk triage focused on caching, batching, streaming. Need quick sanity check before I publish to the CS playbook page.

Liam (AE): drop it here pls. will scan.

Rita (CS): TL;DR goal: give AEs a 2-min checklist, 3 remediation snippets, 1 canned email, and a tiny quality check to run after config changes. Kept it actionable.

Rita (CS): --- PLAYBOOK EXCERPT ---
1) 2-min health quicks: Console -> Usage (7d) + Errors. If tokens down >30% or 5xx spike >2% open ticket.
2) Deployment mode: note Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (affects batch/quant settings).
3) Streaming vs Polling: confirm whether `stream=true` is used. If streaming was toggled off recently, ask customer why (firewall, proxies?).
4) Prefill/cache warmup: recommend sending top-20 prompts as prefetch during off-peak window.
5) Batching window: check whether client uses micro-batches (<=8ms inter-request) vs larger windows (100-250ms). Large windows save cost but can change token ordering/latency.
6) Quality smoke: run 5 canonical prompts pre/post change and compare outputs for truncation or missing tool calls.
7) Action capture: assign owner, ETA, and desired metric (e.g., restore tokens to 90% baseline).
--- END ---

Nora (Solutions): Love it. Add a tiny 'what to attach to ticket' list: console snapshot, last 50 request_ids, sample response diffs.

Rita (CS): added. Below are the three remediation snippets to copy into the AE reply.

Rita (CS): Snippet A - quick usage check
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/usage?tenant=TENANT_ID&window=7d" | jq .tokens.daily
```

Rita (CS): Snippet B - prefetch / cache-warmup POST (async)
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefetch
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "tenant_id":"TENANT_ID",
  "prompts":["<top-20 customer prompts>"],
  "priority":"low"
}
```

Rita (CS): Snippet C - safe batching change checklist (do this in staging first)
```
# increase batching window to 150ms
PATCH /v1/tenants/TENANT_ID/config
{"batch_window_ms":150}
# run smoke eval
python tools/smoke_eval.py --tenant TENANT_ID --cases smoke_cases.json
```

Ethan (Onboarding): Can we include a 1-click survey (short) + canned email to schedule the pairing? saves time.

Rita (CS): Yes. Canned email below (3 lines). Also a 1-click survey link variable that AEs can paste.

Rita (CS): CANNED EMAIL
"Hi <Name>
We spotted reduced request volume / perf variance for your project. Would you have 30 minutes this week for a quick pairing to review caching & streaming settings?
Thanks,
<Name> (Redwood)"

Liam (AE): Simple and good. For survey add a checkbox for deployment_mode and ask if they use streaming.

Kai (Product): Add a line in the playbook reminding AEs to capture model/version and quantization profile before making changes. That explains quality deltas.

Rita (CS): noted. Added 'model+quantization' to ticket attachments. Also adding minimal escalation path: eng-oncall for >3% 5xx for >1h or inability to restore tokens after warmup.

cs-bot: Reminder: playbook draft review due 2110005000.

Nora (Solutions): One more micro-suggestion: include a one-liner troubleshooting flow for streaming fallbacks: if streaming fails, switch to chunked polling with identical prompts and compare latencies. Add sample code snippet.

Rita (CS): added tiny polling fallback snippet.
```
# Polling fallback example
POST /v1/generate?stream=false
{
  "tenant_id":"TENANT_ID",
  "prompt":"<example prompt>",
  "timeout_ms":30000
}
```

Rita (CS): Final next steps: I'll create the one-pager in Confluence, attach these snippets, add a Typeform short survey, and publish to CS playbooks. If anyone wants edit access ping me.

Liam (AE): plz cc me when published.

Ethan (Onboarding): Also drop a short note in onboarding checklist to run prefetch during go-live.

Rita (CS): done. Thanks team :thumbsup:
